review.text: ¡Las chuletas de cordero estaban increíbles! El personal fue muy amable y el lassi de mango, buenísimo. Volveremos pronto.

fields.name: Ember & Spice Grill
fields.tone_notes: Warm, friendly and family-run. We talk to customers like regulars, even on their first visit. Short, upbeat sentences with a little East London charm. Use the customer's first name. Never pushy or salesy. Always say thank you. On bad reviews: apologise sincerely, never argue, and invite them back to make it right.
fields.halal_statement: All our meat is halal, certified by HMC.
fields.allergen_statement: Our kitchen handles nuts, sesame, gluten and dairy. Please tell our team about any allergy before you order.
recovery_offers: A free dessert on your next visit

content.text:

checks.reason: Warm, short, upbeat, uses first name and says thank you, as the profile's tone notes ask.
Names the lamb chops and mango lassi from the review.
The review is in Spanish and the reply is in Spanish. The English sign-off is the profile's sign-off name.
Opening '¡Gracias, Lucía!' and closing '¡Os esperamos muy pronto!' differ from the recent replies.
No em-dashes, no banned words, and one emoji, which is within the profile's limit of 1 for review replies.
The dishes come from the review and match the menu. 'Pasaremos vuestras palabras al equipo' is a courtesy promise, not a factual claim.
No dates or times in the draft.
'Lucía' matches the review author. 'Chuletas de cordero' and 'lassi de mango' match the review and the menu items Lamb Chops and Mango Lassi.
No food, halal, allergen or dietary claims.
No targeting and no wording aimed at personal traits.
Nothing offered in exchange for a review.
Only the name the reviewer shared publicly and what she wrote.
No financial, tax, legal or staffing advice.
Plain text reply that follows Google review reply norms.

Replies in the review's language, signs off with the profile's sign-off name, has no invented facts, and names no staff or order details. The emoji is allowed, there are no hashtags, and the opening and closing are not reused.
